title: Gate visual_refresh-only style overrides behind theme.flags.visualDesignRefresh via css(base, condition && overrides)
answers: How do I add a visual-refresh-only style override to a component?
What's the convention for conditional styling based on the visual design refresh flag?
TableInputCSV footer looks wrong in visual_refresh theme
body: Convention: components that need different styling under the visual refresh theme check `theme.flags.visualDesignRefresh` and pass the extra styles as a second, conditional object to emotion's `css(base, visualRefreshEnabled && { ... })` rather than branching the whole style block. Seen in RadioButton.tsx and TableInputCSV.tsx getStyles. Constraints: use this pattern for visual-refresh-specific tweaks (radius, background/text token swaps) so base styles stay shared and visual_refresh overrides remain easy to find/remove once the refresh becomes the only theme.
